title: Independence polynomials of graphs
summary: In this paper, we study the independence polynomial $P_G(x)$ of a finite simple graph $G$, with emphasis on the evaluation at $x=-1$, symmetry, and its connection with the $h$-polynomial of the edge ideal of $G$. For big star graphs, we determine exactly when $P_G(-1)$ is $0, 1$, or $-1$, characterize the pseudo-Gorenstein$^*$ members, and show that there is a unique big star with symmetric independence polynomial.
